caption: The drawing depicts two ornate crosses labeled "A" and "B" positioned side by side against a light beige background. Cross A is larger and features a design with vivid red, green, and yellow colors. Its top section has a yellow cross outlined in red inside a rectangle, and both the horizontal and vertical arms of the cross are decorated with intertwining organic patterns in green and red with yellow backgrounds, enclosed by borders shaded in gray and blue. Circular and scalloped gray elements accentuate the ends and corners of the cross. Cross B is smaller and is colored in warm yellow with elaborate red geometric patterns and scrollwork, including diamonds, dots, swirling lines, and a circular motif near the lower end of the vertical arm. Its four ends have similar gray and blue circular decorations as those on Cross A. The composition includes carefully detailed ornamentation and repeated use of symmetrical shapes and patterns for both crosses.
title: Plate 47: Crosses of Tin: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
